data.name: Fatihi
data.gender_notes: Fatihi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fatha', meaning to open, expand, or conquer. In Islamic context, Fatihi refers to someone who opens the way to knowledge, guidance, or success. It is a name of great significance for Muslims, as it reflects the Prophet Muhammad's mission to spread the message of Islam and open the path to salvation and spiritual enlightenment.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of opening the heart to guidance and knowledge.
data.etymology: Fatihi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Opener, Opener of the Way.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatihi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فاتحي
in_arabic.meaning: فاتحي يعني الشخص الذي يفتح القلوب و العقول للحق و الخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاتحي مشتق من الفاتح، و هي من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الفتح و الانفتاح على الخير و الحق. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالفتح الإلهي و الإرشاد. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: 'والفتح المبين'، و هذا يدل على أن الفتح يأتي من الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: فاتحی
in_urdu.meaning: فاتحی مطلب ہے جو شخص دل اور دماغ کو حق اور خیر کے لئے کھولتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام فاتحی فتح سے ماخوذ ہے، اور یہ ان ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو خیر اور حق کے لئے کھلنے اور کھولنے کا اظہار کرتے ہیں۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں گہری معانی رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ الہی فتح اور ہدایت سے منسلک ہے۔ جیسا کہ قرآن کریم میں کئی بار ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جیسے: 'والفتح المبين'، یہ ظاہر کرتا ہے کہ فتح اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے آتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फातिही
in_hindi.meaning: फातिही का अर्थ है जो हृदय और मस्तिष्क को सच्चाई और अच्छाई के लिए खोलता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम फातिही فتح से लिया गया है, और यह उन नामों में से एक है जो अच्छाई और सच्चाई के लिए खुलने और खोलने को व्यक्त करते हैं। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में गहरी अर्थ रखता है, क्योंकि यह ईश्वरीय فتح और मार्गदर्शन से जुड़ा हुआ है। जैसे कि कुरआन में कई बार उल्लेख किया गया है, जैसे: 'والفتح المبين', यह दर्शाता है कि فتح अल्लाह की ओर से आता है।

in_pashto.name: فتحي
in_pashto.meaning: فتحي دى هغه کسانو لپاره چې د زړونو او ذهنونو د حق او خير لپاره پراني
in_pashto.long_meaning: د فتحي نوم د فتح څخه اخستل شوی دی، او دا د هغو نومونو څخه يو دی چی د خير او حق لپاره د پراني او خلاصي څرګندوي. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کي ژورې ماناګانې لري، ځکه دا د الهي فتح او هدايت سره تړلی دی. لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کريم کي څو ځله ياد شوي، لکه: 'والفتح المبين'، دا ښيي چې فتح د الله تعالی څخه راځي.

in_english.name: Fatihi
in_english.meaning: Fatihi means the one who opens hearts and minds to truth and goodness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fatihi is derived from 'Fatih', which expresses opening and uncovering for the sake of goodness and truth. This name carries deep meanings in Islamic culture, as it is associated with divine opening and guidance. As mentioned several times in the Quran, such as: 'والفتح المبين', it indicates that the opening comes from Allah. The name Fatihi signifies a person who brings enlightenment, understanding, and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fatihi has a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. It was bestowed upon those who played a pivotal role in the expansion of the Islamic civilization, particularly during the time of the rightly-guided Caliphs, when the Islamic state was expanding rapidly. Fatihi was a name for leaders, conquerors, and scholars who played a crucial role in the growth and development of the Islamic world. For example, the famous Turkish conqueror Fatih Sultan Mehmed, who conquered Constantinople in 1453, carried this name in honor of his mission to open new territories for Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fatihi holds great spiritual significance for Muslims, as it reflects the Prophet Muhammad's mission to spread the message of Islam and open the path to salvation and spiritual enlightenment. As Muslims, we believe that every human being is in need of guidance and spiritual development. Fatihi, as a name, reminds us of the importance of opening the way to knowledge, truth, and righteousness in our lives. It is a reminder of the Prophet's mission to guide us to the straight path and to help us overcome the challenges of life, both in this world and the next. As such, the name Fatihi is a source of inspiration and motivation for Muslims to strive towards knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual growth, and to contribute to the propagation of Islam in word and deed.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Fatih' was given to Sultan Mehmed II in 1453 after he conquered Constantinople (Istanbul).
historical_references.context: End of the Ottoman Empire's European expansion into the Balkans.

historical_references.reference: Another Fatih was Caliph Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz (682-720 AD), who ruled during the Umayyad Caliphate and is considered a just and wise ruler. He was called 'Fatih' because he expanded and consolidated the Islamic dominions in the Iberian Peninsula and North Africa.
historical_references.context: Umayyad Caliphate's expansion into the Iberian Peninsula and North Africa.
